title: Reporter Injection
prompt: Create a class Order totals calculator: Order(items) where items is a list of prices. Its total() returns the sum. Add a constructor parameter reporter=None; if provided, total() must call reporter(total_value) once. This is dependency injection for observability.

tests.name: totals without a reporter
tests.hint: reporter defaults to None; total works without it.

tests.name: calls the reporter once with the total
tests.hint: A list's append is a function — pass it as the reporter.
